verdict.rationale: Clara has a few product-native background behaviors. Cards can be configured to auto-delete after a period end date (enableAutoDeletion), and the marketing site claims automated expense reporting and approvals plus an 'automated CFO agent' in Clara Intelligence. There is no documented user-facing way to define general automations that run on their own. The API, webhooks and MCP are developer building blocks or on-demand assistant access, not background automation, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented automation or rule builder for user-defined background workflows, triggers and actions, details on how the CFO agent runs autonomously, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
